The warriors have narrowed the space. Zahhak is near the SOUTH wall of the recess, facing north, staff planted beside him. Fereydun is one step in front of him with mace still below striking height.
SOUND
Close uneven breathing, fabric pressure, footsteps at the specified level, staff contacts on stone, subtle scales against clothing, restrained practical-lamp hum and hall resonance.
